findings.original_title: Password reset permits account takeover
findings.change: Reset replies are identical for known/unknown addresses. Tokens only go to email, are single-use, expire, and reset requests are rate-limited. UI no longer exposes a reset link.
findings.verification: Reset response generic and token private; Email reset consumes token and revokes existing sessions
findings.remaining_validation: SMTP inbox delivery still needs configured credentials.
findings.recommended_fix: Return one generic response for known/unknown emails. Deliver tokens only through email; remove direct links and token logs in every environment exposed to users. Rate-limit reset requests.

findings.original_title: Public seeding restores known administrator credentials
findings.change: Removed public HTTP seeding and startup seeding. Explicit loopback-only seed command creates random local credentials and preserves existing users/passwords.
findings.verification: Seed endpoint removed; seed-local.js inspection
findings.remaining_validation: Existing installations must rotate/remove historical demo accounts before exposure.
findings.recommended_fix: Remove the HTTP seed route and automatic production seeding. Provide an explicit local-only seed command with generated test accounts; never update an existing account password during seeding.

findings.original_title: Production test-purchase route bypasses payment
findings.change: Removed payment routes, handlers, gateway SDKs, checkout page, receipts, financial UI and pricing fields. Published courses enroll for free. Legacy financial fields are redacted and the backed-up local database was migrated without deleting learning records.
findings.verification: 115-test regression suite: legacy-priced courses enroll for free, financial payloads rejected, legacy fields redacted, removed gateway URLs return 404; UI-11 free classroom lifecycle.
findings.remaining_validation: No payment provider integration remains; historical order collections are retained offline in the database and are not exposed by the app.
findings.recommended_fix: Remove this route from production. Use Stripe test mode and a verified payment-success event for test purchases, with explicitly separated demo accounting.

findings.original_title: Client-forged quiz earns a paid-course certificate
findings.change: Certification uses server-stored keys, enrollment, published status, validated lessons and owned timed attempts. Client question/key payloads are rejected. Verification requires a passed stored attempt.
findings.verification: Forged paid certificate blocked; Supplied question key rejected; Server scores stored key and issues backed certificate
findings.remaining_validation: Offline question templates remain generic practice content, not an academic accreditation.
findings.recommended_fix: Store a server-created assessment attempt and answer key. Accept only attempt ID and student answers. Recheck enrollment, course status, valid lesson completion, time/attempt limits and role before grading or issuing a certificate.

findings.original_title: Course editor silently loses private video URLs
findings.change: Owners/admins retain private lesson media when editing. Public responses redact protected media. Editor persists the correct videoDuration field and stops review submission after a save failure.
findings.verification: Owner retains private URLs and totals; Prior fix-phase browser FIX-UI-09
findings.remaining_validation: Cloudinary upload delivery requires real service credentials; direct lesson URLs were tested.
findings.recommended_fix: Return full edit content to the owning instructor and admin through an ownership-protected endpoint. Ensure read redaction cannot be saved back as destructive updates.

findings.original_title: Invented lesson IDs complete a course
findings.change: Completion rejects nonexistent lessons and invented watch time. Bounded server heartbeats credit elapsed sessions; valid saved curriculum determines progress. Progress alone does not issue a certificate.
findings.verification: Invalid lesson rejected; Faked watch time rejected; Server watch heartbeat validates completion without issuing certificate; Prior fix-phase browser FIX-UI-01
findings.remaining_validation: Heartbeats are a practical progress gate, not tamper-proof evidence of human attention.
findings.recommended_fix: Validate lesson existence in that course, unique completion, finite nonnegative watch time, and the intended completion policy. Calculate progress from valid curriculum IDs only.

findings.original_title: Instructor boundaries fail for quizzes and assignments
findings.change: Quiz/assignment reads and creation require course ownership or permitted enrollment. Students cannot read reference keys; other instructors cannot manage these records.
findings.verification: Other teacher quiz read/create blocked; Assignment other teacher read/create blocked; Student private answer key redacted
findings.recommended_fix: Resolve the course owner for every read/create operation; permit only that owner, admin, or enrolled students with redacted responses.

findings.original_title: Instructor updates bypass moderation
findings.change: Whitelisted instructor updates reject moderation/system fields. Editing a published course returns it to draft. Only administrators publish; review validates lecture media.
findings.verification: Moderation mass assignment blocked; Self publishing blocked; Review submission; browser instructor review flow
findings.recommended_fix: Whitelist editable course fields and implement explicit role-based status transitions. Reserve moderation fields and published state for admin or a documented approved-revision workflow.

findings.original_title: Advertised classroom and AI studio APIs are missing
findings.change: Implemented batch join, persisted batch quizzes, assignment drafting, instructor gradebook and owner-controlled resource hubs. Validated batch deadlines and HTTP(S) resource links.
findings.verification: Instructor batch quiz dispatch; Instructor gradebook exists; Resource hub saves; Prior fix-phase browser FIX-UI-07/08
findings.remaining_validation: Drafts from offline templates need instructor review; optional live AI calls were not verified.
findings.recommended_fix: Implement and test the intended backend contracts and persistence, or clearly disable/label these features as planned. Add a frontend/backend route contract check.

findings.original_title: Discussion authorization can be bypassed
findings.change: Discussion course association and enrollment are checked on replies/votes. Resolution is limited to author, course owner or admin.
findings.verification: Discussion membership and course association
findings.recommended_fix: Authorize against discussion.course, enforce path course equality, and restrict resolve to author, course instructor or admin.

findings.original_title: AI memory feedback and notes are public
findings.change: AI routes require authentication and per-account quotas. Feedback and insights are scoped to the signed-in account and derived from actual saved records.
findings.verification: AI authentication cases; Private feedback, real counts
findings.recommended_fix: Require authentication and per-user scoping for memory. Return aggregate metrics without notes/names to public callers. Add per-user quotas and strict input sizes for AI calls.

findings.original_title: Saved notes leak between accounts on one browser
findings.change: Saved notes use account-owned API storage. Removed shared browser-note storage and starter-note claims; account changes clear the SWR cache boundary.
findings.verification: Private notes persisted and isolated; SWRProvider inspection
findings.remaining_validation: Old shared localStorage notes are deliberately not imported into an arbitrary account.
findings.recommended_fix: Store notes in an authenticated per-user backend library; at minimum use user-scoped local keys and clear in-memory state on logout.

findings.original_title: Valid Stripe webhook is rejected before enrollment
findings.change: Removed payment routes, handlers, gateway SDKs, checkout page, receipts, financial UI and pricing fields. Published courses enroll for free. Legacy financial fields are redacted and the backed-up local database was migrated without deleting learning records.
findings.verification: 115-test regression suite: legacy-priced courses enroll for free, financial payloads rejected, legacy fields redacted, removed gateway URLs return 404; UI-11 free classroom lifecycle.
findings.remaining_validation: No payment provider integration remains; historical order collections are retained offline in the database and are not exposed by the app.
findings.recommended_fix: Register the raw-body webhook before global JSON parsing, then validate signature and implement durable idempotency/error handling. Stripe's official documentation requires unmodified raw bytes.

findings.original_title: Default mobile lesson layout clips the video
findings.change: Lesson navigation starts closed and overlays rather than shrinks the player. Mobile overlay has a visible close button below the navbar; hidden content is inert.
findings.verification: Prior fix-phase browser FIX-UI-04; 390px viewport, scrollWidth=clientWidth=390
findings.recommended_fix: Use a closed-by-default drawer/overlay on narrow screens and preserve a full-width video; label the toggle and check viewport changes.

findings.original_title: Deleting courses leaves broken database references
findings.change: Course deletion archives the course instead of breaking enrollment/quiz/assignment references; enrollment list also tolerates missing historical records.
findings.verification: Archive retains referenced records
findings.remaining_validation: Historical corruption should be reconciled using a backup before any deployment.
findings.recommended_fix: Prefer archive/soft-delete for courses with learning records. Define dependent-record retention/cascade policy and make frontend handling of removed courses explicit.

findings.original_title: Dependency audits report vulnerable production packages
findings.change: Updated application and development dependencies and lockfiles. Replaced the vulnerable Next lint dependency tree with direct ESLint, TypeScript, Hooks, accessibility and unused-import rules.
findings.verification: backend-audit.json and frontend-audit.json: total=0
findings.remaining_validation: Audit results are a dated advisory snapshot, not a guarantee that future advisories will remain zero.
findings.recommended_fix: Review each recorded advisory and reachable feature; upgrade to patched compatible releases and retest. Do not blindly use npm audit fix --force: suggested resolutions include major downgrades for some development packages.

findings.original_title: Password reset leaves old sessions valid
findings.change: JWT tokenVersion is checked against the current account. Password reset increments it and rejects all previously issued sessions.
findings.verification: Email reset consumes token and revokes existing sessions
findings.recommended_fix: Add session/token version or passwordChangedAt validation and revoke sessions on reset; define logout/session expiry behavior.

findings.original_title: Role navigation and hydration guards are inconsistent
findings.change: Central session boundary waits for persisted-auth hydration and server session validation before private content renders. Role dashboards, safe return paths and user-scoped caches are consistent.
findings.verification: Prior fix-phase browser FIX-UI-06; administrator login/direct-load/reload checks
findings.recommended_fix: Centralize hydrated authentication and role guards, add an admin dashboard mapping, and honor a validated same-origin return path after login.

findings.original_title: Draft/unpublished course access is not enforced
findings.change: Unpublished course details are owner/admin only. Enrollment, student material and assessments require published status and permitted membership. Every published course is free; legacy price fields do not restrict enrollment.
findings.verification: Draft read/enrollment denial tests; legacy free enrollment and classroom-code tests; UI-11.
findings.recommended_fix: Restrict unpublished details to the course owner/admin and permit enrollments only for published, available courses.

findings.original_title: Quiz attempts and time limits lack server enforcement
findings.change: Persisted immutable attempts enforce ownership, expiry, attempt count and replay protection. Keys are hidden until submission. Both quiz timers use the server deadline.
findings.verification: Standard attempt scores, persists and enforces maxAttempts; Expired attempt refused; Submitted attempt cannot replay
findings.recommended_fix: Persist per-student attempts with start/end timestamps, immutable scoring, maximum-attempt checks and review release policy.

findings.original_title: Assignment deadlines and grade range are not validated
findings.change: Assignment submissions validate role, deadline, required answer and duplicates. Grades must be finite numbers within the assignment range; unavailable AI grading stays pending.
findings.verification: Assignment deadline enforced; Invalid grade cases; Valid grade saved; Unconfigured live grader fails clearly
findings.remaining_validation: Live OpenAI grading quality still requires service credentials and human review.
findings.recommended_fix: Validate finite score in [0,maxScore], deadline policy, required answer content and any late-submission exceptions.

findings.original_title: Flashcards are a temporary demo, not persisted SM-2
findings.change: Implemented per-account cards, SM-2 repetition/ease/interval/due fields and persistent reviews. Space reveals cards; 1-4 rate them, including when controls have keyboard focus.
findings.verification: SM-2 reviews persist per student; SM-2 schedule math; Prior fix-phase browser FIX-UI-02/03/05
findings.recommended_fix: Label the current deck as a demo or implement per-user cards, repetition/ease/interval/due fields, durable ratings and documented keyboard controls.

findings.original_title: Displayed history, counts and ratings are fabricated
findings.change: History, activity, feedback counts, streaks, lesson totals and SRS metrics derive from stored records. Empty ratings show zero/no ratings. Homepage sample grades are labelled illustrative.
findings.verification: Fresh account history and flashcards are zero; Owner retains private URLs and totals; final instructor screenshot
findings.remaining_validation: Sample curricula are draft examples; a short synthetic video exists only in the ignored local browser fixture.
findings.recommended_fix: Derive metrics from real user records and show honest empty states. Mark illustrative demo values clearly and recompute course lesson/duration totals when saving.

findings.original_title: AI provider and self-learning claims exceed the implementation
findings.change: Assistant now uses configurable OpenAI Responses, owned server history and role-filtered hybrid RAG. A floating window shows sources and truthful provider mode. Unsupported source errors no longer produce generic success output. Offline templates remain labelled; they do not self-train a model.
findings.verification: Backend chat/provider-input/privacy regression; Hindi/Gujarati retrieval UI; history persistence; live-provider quality pending.
findings.remaining_validation: Actual OpenAI generation, embeddings and multilingual follow-up quality require the exact local credential file path. No real provider success is claimed.
findings.recommended_fix: Show actual provider/model and fallback status. Describe stored feedback accurately. Only advertise transcript ingestion, RAG or training after implementing and verifying it.

findings.original_title: Three-question selection generates five questions
findings.change: API accepts only 3, 5 or 10 and enforces the exact requested length in offline and provider processing. Generated question enum fields match the quiz persistence contract.
findings.verification: Exact offline quiz count 3/5/10
findings.remaining_validation: Provider failure/fallback handling is covered locally; real provider output remains unverified.
findings.recommended_fix: Agree one count contract across UI and backend; validate allowed counts and enforce the exact requested length for generated and fallback quizzes.

findings.original_title: Catalog inputs return server errors or unbounded results
findings.change: Route IDs, page/limit bounds and supported sorts are validated. Removed price filters are rejected; production errors return safe messages without database stack traces.
findings.verification: Invalid catalog inputs and ID tests; removed min/max pricing filters rejected.
findings.recommended_fix: Validate IDs, positive integer page, capped limit, category/level and sort allowlists. Return stable 400/404 errors without database details.

findings.original_title: Unreadable PDFs produce successful generic notes
findings.change: Notes accept text PDFs or pasted transcripts, reject corrupt/no-text PDFs and video URLs without transcripts, and limit file count, per-file size and total uploaded bytes. The notes screen retains an inline source error instead of showing fabricated generated content.
findings.verification: Corrupt PDF rejected; Video source requires transcript; Notes generation labelled offline; UI-14 persistent transcript-required error with no generated notes.
findings.remaining_validation: Scanned documents require OCR outside this implementation.
findings.recommended_fix: Require extracted text or explicitly disclose unreadable/scanned documents and OCR needs; validate file types/count/aggregate size and separate video-link-only behavior.

findings.original_title: Discount price and payment amount disagree
findings.change: Removed payment routes, handlers, gateway SDKs, checkout page, receipts, financial UI and pricing fields. Published courses enroll for free. Legacy financial fields are redacted and the backed-up local database was migrated without deleting learning records.
findings.verification: 115-test regression suite: legacy-priced courses enroll for free, financial payloads rejected, legacy fields redacted, removed gateway URLs return 404; UI-11 free classroom lifecycle.
findings.remaining_validation: No payment provider integration remains; historical order collections are retained offline in the database and are not exposed by the app.
findings.recommended_fix: Define one server-side effective-price/currency calculation and use it for catalog, checkout, payment validation, accounting and receipts.

findings.original_title: Accessibility semantics are incomplete
findings.change: Login has associated labels/error references. Named modal dialogs support focus entry/trapping/restoration and Escape. Cards are buttons; icon and sidebar controls have accessible names. Added shared workspace navigation, active states, skip link, associated legacy form labels, named quiz controls, floating assistant language controls and reduced-motion styling.
findings.verification: Accessible browser login; assignment modal Escape restores focus; flashcard Space/numeric controls; mobile close control; 390/1440px dashboard overflow checks; final quiz form labels and shell-preserving lazy loading.
findings.remaining_validation: Keyboard/browser checks are targeted; no formal assistive-technology certification is claimed.
findings.recommended_fix: Connect label/htmlFor/id, add error associations, name icon controls, use real buttons for cards, and provide modal focus entry/trap/restore with Escape dismissal.

findings.original_title: Quality checks and regression suite are not ready
findings.change: Real Node integration suite replaces the missing Jest command. Added CI for Mongo-backed tests, both lint checks, types, build and audits; meaningful lint failures are corrected.
findings.verification: 115 backend tests pass; strict frontend/backend lint, TypeScript and production build pass. CI definition added; no hosted GitHub run claimed.
findings.remaining_validation: CI workflow is added locally; no GitHub run is claimed because changes were not pushed.
findings.recommended_fix: Resolve meaningful lint failures, install/configure a real test runner, remove pass-with-no-tests as the only test expectation, and add regression cases for confirmed defects plus CI.

findings.original_title: Docker recipe expects a missing production artifact
findings.change: Enabled standalone Next output. Docker uses non-root runners, build-time public API variables and no source mounts hiding artifacts. Both images build and run against local Mongo.
findings.verification: docker-build.txt; docker-runtime.json; browser Docker catalog verification
findings.remaining_validation: Docker smoke uses isolated loopback ports and a separate empty QA database; no public deployment occurred.
findings.recommended_fix: Choose a consistent development or production compose workflow; enable standalone for that runner, supply public variables at build time and remove incompatible production source mounts.

findings.original_title: CORS allows every origin with credentials
findings.change: CORS allows only exact configured frontend origins and denies untrusted origins. Permission checks remain mandatory on authenticated endpoints.
findings.verification: Unknown origin has no CORS access
findings.recommended_fix: Use an exact configured origin allowlist and reject unknown origins. Keep authenticated endpoint permissions as the primary security control.

findings.original_title: Public certificate lookup exposes email addresses
findings.change: Public certificate verification returns only recipient display fields and credential data. Email is excluded; invalid/unbacked credentials are rejected. Direct PDF downloads work.
findings.verification: Public certificate email private and PDF works
findings.recommended_fix: Return only fields needed for verification, and define recipient consent and revocation behavior.

findings.original_title: Quick-start and public claims are inconsistent
findings.change: Rewrote README, architecture and internship documentation for the payment-free app, optional server-side AI, role-filtered RAG and secure local setup. Public content, offline labels and notes export copy describe actual behavior.
findings.verification: Source/documentation review; local production build, Docker startup, classroom lifecycle and dashboard browser checks.
findings.remaining_validation: Real SMTP delivery, Cloudinary uploads, OpenAI quality, second-machine setup and public hosting are not validated in this local run.
findings.recommended_fix: Update setup to tested versions/env names, label sample curricula clearly, align free/paid wording and feature status, and read URL filters into state.
